title: North Dining Hall Weekly Cafeteria Menu
inputText:
UNIVERSITY HOSPITALITY & DINING SERVICES
North Campus Dining Hall -- Weekly Lunch & Dinner Menu
Operating Hours: 07:30 - 20:30 Daily

Daily Specials:
- Monday: Tomato Basil Bisque, Grilled Cheddar Panini, Garden Greens
- Tuesday: Roasted Chicken Taco Bowls, Mexican Corn, Black Beans
- Wednesday: Stir-Fry Noodles with Tofu, Spring Rolls, Jasmine Rice
- Thursday: Classic Beef Lasagna, Garlic Baguette, Caesar Salad
- Friday: Beer-Battered Fish Fillet, Hand-Cut Chips, Tartar Sauce

Please note: Meal card swipes valid during designated service hours only. No outside glassware permitted.
